output_and_failure_policy.directories: Use the eight new output and recorder directories exactly as planned. If any planned directory exists, stop before execution to choose a new complete campaign root and record that administrative change. Do not overwrite prior outputs.

output_and_failure_policy.filtered: metrics.safety.nsfw_content_detected=true is a filtered observation even if exit_code=0. Preserve the pipeline-checked image and all metadata; semantic attributes are not_assessable_filtered.
output_and_failure_policy.technical_failure: Preserve failed/launch_failed/timed_out/interrupted status, exit code and full command.log. A progress line saying step N started does not establish completion.
output_and_failure_policy.timeout: Per-request timed_out/exit124 keeps its original slot and all available artifacts. No replacement seed/prompt or retry is added to this eight-request set.

After later failures, continue to the next fixed request only if remaining budget and verified shared prerequisites permit it; stop on an unresolved shared asset/software problem and mark remaining requests not_attempted with blocked reason.
output_and_failure_policy.unfinished: A running record left by host interruption needs process inspection and an explicit interruption note; never infer success from partial files.
output_and_failure_policy.all_results: Publish or index every planned slot, complete original checked images for assessable/filtered outputs, original metrics, external records and exclusions. Preserve raw original PNG bytes; no cropping or selective omission.

observation_protocol.unit: One complete original512x512 image. Two independent AI observers if available; one receives anonymous image IDs and the object-description rubric without prompts, seeds or previous results. Root maps descriptions to predeclared targets after annotations. Record observer identity, whether blind, and all disagreements. Real-reader annotations remain future work.

object_identity.cube: clear requires a coherent cube-like three-dimensional block with visible faces/edges or other convincing volume cues. A flat square or vague angular patch is ambiguous.
object_identity.sphere: clear requires a coherent ball-like rounded volume; a flat disk without sufficiently clear volume cues is ambiguous.
object_identity.multiplicity: Record visible counts of clear cubes/spheres plus extra or merged objects. For each requested target, ambiguity/absence is retained separately; do not select a favorable pair from multiple interchangeable candidates.

color.rule: Judge the visible body of a clearly identified object, allowing watercolor highlights and shading. Dominant red-family or blue-family appearance must be clear; borderline orange/pink/purple/teal or conflicting object colors are mixed_or_uncertain with a descriptive note. If identity is ambiguous/absent, color remains not_assessable. Record observed colors before comparing with the prompt.

horizontal_relation.eligibility: Assess geometry independently of whether colors match, when exactly one clear cube and one clear sphere can be uniquely localized. Missing/ambiguous identities, duplicated interchangeable targets, severe merging or unlocalizable crop yield not_assessable with reason.
horizontal_relation.rule: Use image-coordinate left/right. Record approximate visible bounding boxes when reliably localizable; compare their horizontal centers. A center separation of at least5% of image width (25.6px at512px) with a confident ordering supports left/right; closer centers or unreliable localization are uncertain. Record overlap and cropping separately. Bounding boxes are AI-assisted visual annotations, not detector measurements.

secondary: plain white/light neutral background or additional setting
observation_protocol.target_match: Derive per-attribute match/mismatch/uncertain from blind descriptions and fixed prompts. A complete single-object match requires exactly one clear cube with requested color; a complete relation match requires uniquely clear cube+sphere, both specified colors and the specified left/right relation. Extra objects/secondary qualities are reported separately. Filtered/technical/unstarted slots retain their explicit status.
observation_protocol.disagreement: Preserve both raw annotations. If observers disagree on identity/color/relation and no clearly supported resolution is documented, final item remains uncertain. Do not convert uncertainty to a confident failure or success.
observation_protocol.reporting: Report counts with explicit planned denominator2 for each prompt, including unavailable statuses, plus all same-seed paired cases. No universal success rate, confidence interval, significance claim or model-ranking claim from these eight requests.

interpretation_limits: Watercolor styling makes object geometry and borderline hue subjective; preserve uncertainty and reviewer disagreement.
The two relation prompts change object-phrase order along with the requested layout; conclusions apply to these complete prompt changes.
Same initial noise fixes one stochastic input; prompt changes can also change shape, scale, composition and other content.
Two seeds and four prompts provide cases about this fixed configuration. They do not estimate broader compositional ability or establish general model reliability.
AI reviewers can share biases; observations require later independent human review for stronger claims.
